changelog: Fix: placeholder names showed as cs-tv-… in Moonfin/web. Titles and status are now also written to an NFO next to each placeholder (Jellyfin re-reads it on every scan) and to the item instance Jellyfin serves; NFO reading is turned on for the Coming Soon library. The plugin now creates its library only once and warns if several libraries use the stub folder.
description: Keeps a shared "Coming Soon" library of requested movies and shows that haven't arrived yet, with download progress and ETA in the item overview. Placeholder items are not playable.
name: Coming Soon
overview: Download progress library for Seerr, Sonarr and Radarr
